_lineage.phase: 02.17.17 (schema v2 — all_combos table for runtime quarantine)
_lineage.fee_model: 2% of profit, conservative formula maxBuyPrice = wr/100 - 0.02
_lineage.in_sample_bias_note: Strategy selection is in-sample over the full 720-day window. comboWR is historical maximum, not expected future performance. Phase 02.12+ should add a holdout / rolling-origin validation.
_lineage.runtime_quarantine_note: Each per_city entry includes `all_combos` with every pair/triple that passed MIN_AGREED_DAYS. lib/strategy-overlay-resolver.ts resolves the best non-quarantined combo at request time.
